symptom: The report UI fails axe in e2e: color-contrast on 21 nodes (light-mode Tailwind classes — text-blue-700 links, text-amber-800, amber-50 panel — placed on the shared dark theme where they drop below contrast ratio) and empty-table-header on the findings table's detail column (<th aria-label=... with no text content).
evidence: npx playwright test core-journey.spec.ts → axe violations: 'color-contrast: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds (21 nodes)' and 'empty-table-header: Table header text should not be empty (1 nodes)'.
root_cause: Report pages were styled with light-mode Tailwind palette classes instead of the shared token colors (--color-accent, --color-warning, --color-muted) designed for the dark theme; the trailing table header was left textless.
notes: Found by the repo's own e2e axe gate on first run.
